description: This file defines the 'ReactAgentController' class, which acts as a controller for managing the state and interactions of a React Agent screen in a Flutter application. It handles user input, updates the UI based on agent service state, and provides methods for starting the agent, clearing steps, and getting visual indicators for steps.

classes.name: ReactAgentController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages state and interactions for the React Agent UI, interfacing with an underlying AgentService.

methods.name: ReactAgentController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the controller with an optional AgentService instance and sets up a listener for changes.

methods.name: _onAgentChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the agent service state changes; updates local state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: startAgent
methods.description: Validates user input and initiates the agent process through the agent service.

methods.name: clearSteps
methods.description: Resets the agent service state and clears local data, notifying listeners.

methods.name: setUserInput
methods.description: Updates the user input string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon representation based on the step type.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Provides a color for the step based on its type.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Returns a string title for a given step type.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes the listener from the agent service and performs cleanup.
